title: fix(mcp): the record data tools answer a code-less throw as the /data door does, so an undeclared hook abort is HOOK_ABORTED
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi3qHENwt3pGirMrGoMekDtd)_

Fixes #31218

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的六个记录数据工具(`query_records`、`aggregate_records`、`get_record`、`create_record`、`update_record`、`delete_record`)遇到不带错误码的异常时,改用 `/api/v1/data` 同一个分类函数 `mapDataError` 来回答:沙箱 hook 的业务中止回 `HOOK_ABORTED` + hook 自己写的那句话;代码 hook 的裸 throw、崩溃、驱动错误回 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`,原文不再给 agent,改为在服务端打一条 `[5xx]` 日志。带错误码的异常照旧。
- 为什么改:之前 agent 看到的是沙箱调试包装 `hook 'NAME' threw: Error: …`,没有错误码,还暴露 hook 内部名字;同一个中止在 REST 上是 `400 HOOK_ABORTED`。agent 分不清"业务拒绝"和"故障",场景跑分也读不到码。
- 风险与回滚:这六个工具对无码异常的回答从纯文本变成 JSON 信封 `{ error: { code, message, status } }`,且 5xx 原文被隐去(与 REST 一致);只改 `@objectstack/mcp`,patch。回滚即还原 `mcp-http-tools.ts`。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `dataDoorErrorResult` / `dataDoorAnswerOf`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 末尾的 #31218 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31218`,预期 16 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record data tools of `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` rendered a thrown error that carries no string `code` as its bare message (`errorResult(messageOf(err))`). A QuickJS hook body's `throw new Error('…')` arrives as a `SandboxError` with no `code`, whose `.message` is the `hook 'NAME' threw: Error: …` debug wrapper, so the agent read the wrapper (hook name included) and no `ErrorCode`, while `/api/v1/data` answers the same throw `400 HOOK_ABORTED` with the inner sentence.

- **`dataDoorErrorResult(err, tool, objectName)`**, the catch of `query_records`, `aggregate_records`, `get_record`, and (through `landedWriteResultOrError`'s `otherwise`, now a required argument) `create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`:
  - a coded throw renders through `thrownRefusalEnvelope` exactly as before (read first);
  - a code-less throw renders the `/data` door's answer, `{ "error": { "code", "message", "status" } }`, read off `mapDataError(err, objectName)` (`@objectstack/types`) by `dataDoorAnswerOf`. No second classification exists in `packages/mcp`;
  - a 5xx answer is logged once through `logServerFault` (`[5xx] 500 tools/call update_record task — THROWN-MESSAGE`), since its message no longer reaches the agent.
- **`rowRefusalOf`** (the per-row grouping of `delete_records`, #30891) reads the same `dataDoorAnswerOf` instead of its own inline read of `mapDataError`; its answers are unchanged.
- **`codedErrorResult`** accepts an envelope without `code`, for a throw that declared a status and no code (the door invents none).
- **No change** to `@objectstack/types`, `packages/spec`, the other tools, or the coded path.

The family, each answered as the door answers it (pinned at the MCP door, each asserted literally AND equal to `mapDataError` on the same throw):

| Throw | Before (MCP) | Now (MCP) = `/data` |
|---|---|---|
| sandboxed hook abort, no code (`SandboxError`, `innerMessage`) | text `hook 'demoleave_leave_request_guard' threw: Error: Not enough annual leave remaining` | `HOOK_ABORTED` · 400 · `Not enough annual leave remaining` |
| the same abort with the `SandboxError` instance lost (wrapper text only) | the wrapper text | `HOOK_ABORTED` · 400 · inner sentence |
| sandboxed abort that declared `status: 422`, no code | the wrapper text | `HOOK_ABORTED` · 422 |
| code hook's bare `throw new Error(…)` | its message | `INTERNAL_ERROR` · 500 · `Internal server error` (message logged) |
| sandboxed body that crashed (`TypeError: …`) | the wrapper text | `INTERNAL_ERROR` · 500 |
| runtime `callData`'s `{ statusCode: 503, message: 'Data service not available' }` | its message | no code · 503 · `Internal server error` (message logged) |
| `{ statusCode: 400, message }`, no code | its message | no code · 400 · its message |
| coded refusal (`RECORD_LOCKED` / 409) — CONTROL | coded envelope | unchanged, not logged |

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: a new top-level describe (#31218), in the shared `/mcp` HTTP harness (`rpcOverHttp`, `bridgeThrowing`): the undeclared abort for each of the six tools (hook name and `threw` absent from the text), the lost-instance wrapper, the declared-4xx abort, the 4xx-is-not-logged pin, the bare throw (message withheld, one `[5xx]` line naming tool and object), the crash, the 503, the declared 400 with no code, the coded CONTROL on every data tool, and a CONTROL that the other tools still answer a code-less throw with its bare message. The #23509 table's "code-less throw answers its bare message" row now splits: data tools answer the door's 500, the rest are unchanged. The "not a code" row moves to `list_actions`, which still renders that case.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.http.test.ts`: two pins that threw an uncoded `Error` read the new answer. The aggregate pin's fixture becomes the coded `PermissionDeniedError` the security plugin really throws for that denial (`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`).

<details><summary>Base re-measure (order step 1) and ablation</summary>

Base re-measure: `mcp-http-tools.ts` restored to the base blob (2b752f12, hash match checked), the #31218 block run: `Tests 13 failed | 3 passed | 46 skipped (62)`. Each data tool's text was `hook 'demo…` (`SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'h', "hook 'demo"... is not valid JSON`, ×5 tools + the lost-instance row), and the 503 / bare / 400 rows answered `Data servi…` / `Not enough…` / `aggregate …` as bare text. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Ablation (one-time, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): in `dataDoorErrorResult`, `return codedErrorResult(door);` replaced by `return errorResult(messageOf(err));`. `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 15cb855c1f9c -> 62f6a65d8a2b`; `src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: `Tests 19 failed | 43 passed (62)` (the 13 rows above plus the 6 table rows); `ok restored: blob == HEAD (15cb855c1f9c) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The test imports the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Still answered differently from REST, not changed here (listed for the seat):**
  - a CODED sandboxed refusal (`throw` with `code` + `status` in a hook body) answers the wrapper text with the hook name, `{ code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', message: "hook 'guard' threw: Error: Locked.", status: 409 }`, measured on `MCPServerRuntime`; `/data` answers the inner sentence. `thrownRefusalEnvelope` reads `.message`; the order kept the coded path unchanged.
  - the metadata tools (`list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression`), `list_actions`, the record resource, `run_action` / `resume_run` and `delete_records`' outer catch still render a code-less throw as its bare message. `delete_records`' outer catch also renders this file's own code-less sentences, which the door's message heuristics would misread (its "could not read the records" sentence names the object and contains `not`, the unknown-object limb), so it keeps `errorResultWithCode`.
  - `delete_records`' fault answer still quotes the faulting row's thrown message.
  - a driver's own string `code` (`SQLITE_BUSY`) rides the coded path with its message, where `/data` answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
- The 5xx log line is `logServerFault`'s, with `request: { method: 'tools/call', path: 'TOOL OBJECT' }` as its coordinates; the MCP tool layer has no HTTP request in hand.
